{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()}")

# Check the revenue column
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head(5).tolist()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {df['status'].eq('refunded').sum()}")

# Check for the 6 QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df['revenue'].eq('999999.99')
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_orders.sum()}")

# Summary of the current state
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique statuses: {df['status'].unique().tolist()}")"}
